facts.fact: 塞雷娜的幻觉碎裂的同时，裹住伊莱的冰也跟着碎了。
facts.anchor: THE moment Serena’s illusion shattered, so did the ice surrounding Eli

facts.fact: 现实回来，姐妹俩那栋亮着灯的房子被疯人宅邸取代。
facts.anchor: the sisters’ well-lit house replaced by Madman’s Mansion

facts.fact: 伊莱单膝跪地、喉咙里挤出一声粗响，血从鼻子、眼睛、耳朵里滴下来。
facts.anchor: blood dripping from his nose, his eyes, his ears

facts.fact: 伊莱刚开始猎杀 EO 时头部中过一枪。
facts.anchor: Eli had been shot in the head

facts.fact: 当年他用尖嘴钳花了近十分钟，才把子弹从自己头里挖出来。
facts.anchor: a pair of needle-nose pliers and the better part of ten minutes

facts.fact: 诺亚的声音同时在房间里和他耳边响起，报出已获取 B 目标、正在追 A 目标。
facts.anchor: Noah’s voice played in the room and in his ear

facts.fact: 伊莱一镖打进诺亚喉咙根部，把他放倒后跨了过去。
facts.anchor: a single dart into the base of Noah’s throat

facts.fact: 一缕金发在头顶一闪而过，他认出是西德妮，拔枪去追。
facts.anchor: a wisp of blond hair vanished overhead
